page: City page: B2B lead generation Shanghai (/b2b-lead-generation-shanghai)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Shanghai?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to Shanghai work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the Shanghai market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for Shanghai built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with Shanghai buyers, mainly manufacturers, multinationals' China offices and pharma companies. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into China. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in Shanghai. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in Shanghai and send in their working hours. Shanghai is 2.5 hours ahead of India, so meetings fit easily into an Indian working day. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for Shanghai buyers?
items.answer: China's Personal Information Protection Law sets strict rules on collecting personal information and on transferring it abroad. Campaigns are scoped with you, and checked with counsel, before launch, and we contact people in their business roles only. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
